local P=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local done=workspace:GetAttribute('QADone') or '' local pref={"새 게임"} local skip={"삭제","초기화","나가기","종료","구매 확정","결제","Robux","로벅스"} local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize local function shown(d) local x=d while x and x~=P do if x:IsA('GuiObject') and not x.Visible then return false end if x:IsA('LayerCollector') and not x.Enabled then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==P end local function label(d) if d:IsA('TextButton') and d.Text~='' then return (d.Text:gsub('\n',' ')) end for _,c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do if c:IsA('TextLabel') and c.Text~='' then return c.Text end end return d.Name end local function keyOf(d) local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') local oy=sf and 0 or math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.Y/20) return label(d)..'@'..(sf and sf.Name or '')..math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.X/20)..','..(sf and (d.LayoutOrder or 0) or oy) end local best,bs=nil,-1 for _,d in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do if (d:IsA('TextButton') or d:IsA('ImageButton')) and d.AbsoluteSize.X>8 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>8 and shown(d) then local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') local inview=d.AbsolutePosition.X>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.X<vp.X and d.AbsolutePosition.Y>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y<vp.Y if inview or sf then local l=label(d) local key=keyOf(d) local bad=false for _,s in ipairs(skip) do if string.find(l,s,1,true) then bad=true end end if not bad and not string.find(done,key,1,true) then local sc=0 for i,p in ipairs(pref) do if string.find(l,p,1,true) then sc=100-i end end if sc>bs then bs=sc best=d end end end end end if not best then return 'NONE' end local sf=best:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') if sf then local off=best.AbsolutePosition.Y-sf.AbsolutePosition.Y+sf.CanvasPosition.Y-(sf.AbsoluteSize.Y-best.AbsoluteSize.Y)/2 sf.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,off)) end return 'SCROLLED '..label(best)

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local r=RS:WaitForChild('GameAction') local step,a='?',nil for i=1,14 do task.wait(1.5) a=r:InvokeServer('State',{}) step=(a and a.view and a.view.captain and a.view.captain.step) or '?' if step=='done' then break end end if step=='done' then return 'INTRO_OK' end local note='INTRO_STUCK step='..tostring(step) if step=='name' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroName',{name='QA선장'}) note=note..' name='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='companion' end if step=='companion' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroCompanion',{}) note=note..' comp='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='portrait' end if step=='portrait' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroPortrait',{portrait='hero:england'}) note=note..' portrait='..tostring(x and x.ok) end task.wait(0.5) workspace:SetAttribute('DevCall','State') return note
